title: Controlling Odoo ERP with an AI Agent over MCP
summary: Joseph Fluckiger connects an AI agent to Odoo, an open-source ERP system, through an MCP server.
learn: An agent system interprets a question, selects tools, makes decisions and reflects on the response.
He configured an existing MCP server for Odoo running locally in Docker, using Claude Desktop.
Live demo: count employees, create an employee and create a product through the ERP API.
MCP has three kinds of assets: resources, prompts and tools; with the Python mcp package you mark methods as resources.
The next step is constraining the agent so it does the right thing, since it can change a lot in the ERP.
